<!-- Source page: Jitsi Meet -->

[Jitsi Meet](https://github.com/jitsi/jitsi-meet) is a complete, private, self-hosted video conferencing solution.

It is documented in the [NixOS manual](https://nixos.org/manual/nixos/stable/#module-services-jitsi-meet).
